_about: Reader-facing pictures and songs for codex.md entries the Codex renders outside Sayings (a person, place or faction with its own file takes its picture there). Claude-owned. name: the entry's bold name exactly; then an image, an audio file or both. image: a path under saga/art/ (e.g. codex/thistle.jpg); image_alt: what the picture shows; image_caption (optional) and image_focus (optional, "X% Y%"). audio: a song under saga/art/songs/ (.mp3, .m4a, .ogg or .opus, up to 10 MB); audio_title (optional): the title its player shows, else the entry's name. It plays in the Codex entry and in the story wherever the page sings a line its codex.md entry quotes in italics, or links its name. The picture may show only what the page has put on the page; a song may sing only what the page has sung (the build checks an MP3's embedded lyrics).
